hooks.name: TechLead No Source Read
hooks.description: Blocks the TechLead orchestrator from reading source files in src/ — that work belongs to subagents

action.prompt: You are the TechLead orchestrator. Reading source files (src/**/*.cs) is forbidden — that is subagent work. If you need to understand a problem, dispatch a workflow agent to investigate. Only docs (*.md), config (.kiro/**), and AGENTS.md are allowed for direct reading. If this read_file call targets a src/**/*.cs file, stop and delegate to a subagent instead.
